notes_for_editor: Low confidence and thin: the only record for Devils is the association listing. No agency, build date, design, height, staffing or site source was found, and no source names this tower apart from that listing. The Murphy column describes an unnamed tower just south of Red Hills Lake on Highway 87 in Sabine County. It cannot be matched to the Devils point (31.26653, -93.68867), so the story does not treat the two as the same site. The story runs slightly under 120 words because the evidence is one listing plus background. Recommend a check of Texas Forest Service records and a Sabine County map search before expansion.
